summary: Tom Ashe contacted HomeNet because he was locked out of his online account and needed assistance resetting the password. The agent sent him a secure link to reset it via email. After successfully setting a new password, Tom logged back in and confirmed that everything is working correctly.

ratings.name: Branding and Survey
ratings.reason: The agent used the correct greeting and offered a post-call survey.

ratings.name: Empathy and Acknowledgment
ratings.reason: – The agent acknowledged Tom’s frustration with being locked out of his account, showing understanding.

ratings.name: Rapport and Professionalism
ratings.reason: The agent maintained a polite tone and avoided any defensive language.

ratings.name: Verified Customer
ratings.reason: – The agent validated Tom’s name and email address, confirming his identity.

ratings.name: Probing
ratings.reason: The agent asked clarifying questions about the specific problem (the inability to log in).

ratings.name: Active Listening
ratings.reason: The agent listened attentively to Tom's explanation of the problem.

intense.speaker: Client
intense.text: I'm locked out of my online account, I can't log in.

suggestions: Tom Ashe is locked out of his online account.
He was sent a secure password reset link to tom.ashe@email.com.
Check the email inbox for the password reset link immediately.
Encourage Tom to choose a strong, unique new password.

compliance.name: Discourtesy
compliance.rule: Never be discourteous: no profanity, bashing, impatience, or sarcasm toward the customer

compliance.name: Escalation
compliance.rule: Escalate to a supervisor when the customer asks

compliance.name: Call Avoidance
compliance.rule: Do not avoid the call: never refuse to help or push the customer away without a valid reason

response_times.client_text: I'm locked out of my online account, I can't log in.
response_times.agent_text: No problem, I'll help you get back in. Let me verify your identity first.
Can you confirm your name and the email on the account?
Thank you, Tom. I'll send a secure password reset link to that email now.
Great, click the link and set a new password.

response_times.client_text: Done, it let me set a new one.
response_times.agent_text: Now try logging in with the new password.
Excellent. As a tip, I'd avoid reusing old passwords to keep the account secure.
Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Great, have a good day, Tom.

accuracy.client_question: I'm locked out of my online account, I can't log in.
accuracy.matched_question: I want to cancel my subscription and close my account.
accuracy.agent_answer: No problem, I'll help you get back in. Let me verify your identity first.
accuracy.ideal_answer: I can help you cancel. I'll verify your identity, explain any final charges, and confirm the cancellation date. If you'd prefer, I can also note the reason so we can improve. There's no fee to cancel.
missed: agree to help with the cancellation
explain any final charges and the cancellation date
confirm there is no fee to cancel

accuracy.matched_question: This is the third time I've called about the same issue.
accuracy.agent_answer: Now try logging in with the new password.
accuracy.ideal_answer: I'm sorry you've had to call this many times, that's not good enough. Let me pull up your history so you don't have to repeat yourself, and I'll either resolve it now or escalate it with a reference so it's seen through to the end.

take ownership instead of asking them to repeat everything
